# FAQ-004 Engineering FAQ #4

Revision: Rev A

Q: What lubricant is specified for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01)?
A: The lubricant part number for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is CFW-LUB-225. Confirm application and replenishment per SOP-P2-L4-04 and ECN-2026-010.

Q: What is the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01)?
A: The target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C. Verify control setpoint against ECN-2026-046 before production runs.

Q: What austenitizing temperature setpoint should be used on Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02)?
A: The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 885 °C. Record deviations and corrective actions per SOP-P2-L4-04.

Q: What is the minimum coil cooling water flow for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03)?
A: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 65 L/min. Monitor flow alarms and log trips in accordance with ECN-2026-010.

Q: What spindle warm-up time is required for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02)?
A: The spindle warm-up time for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is 21 minutes. Include warm-up in job setup checklists and reference ECN-2026-046 for any changes.

Related documents: ECN-2026-010, ECN-2026-046, SOP-P2-L4-04
